## `UEAssetLens.AssetSemanticToolset.SearchAssets`

Multi-funnel hybrid asset retrieval; returns compact TOON candidates + co-occurring bundle.

| --- | --- |
| `name` | `UEAssetLens.AssetSemanticToolset.SearchAssets` |
| `accessMode` | `Read` |
| `readOnlyHint` | `true` |
| `annotations` | `{accessMode: Read, readOnlyHint: true}` |
| `meta` | `{accessMode: Read}` |

### inputSchema

```yaml
type: object
properties:
  query:
    type: string
    description: Natural-language keywords (DuckDB FTS BM25)
  asset_class:
    type: string
    description: e.g. AnimMontage, NiagaraSystem, StaticMesh
  filters:
    type: object
    description: 'Hard constraints: skeleton, duration_min/max, min/max_forward_cm,
      dominant_limb'
  domain_scope:
    type: string
    description: Directory whitelist, e.g. /Game/Characters/Knight
  limit:
    type: integer
    default: 8
```

| 参数 | 类型 | 必填 | 默认值 | 说明 |

| `filters` | `object` | 否 |  | Hard constraints: skeleton, duration_min/max, min/max_forward_cm, dominant_limb |
| `domain_scope` | `string` | 否 |  | Directory whitelist, e.g. /Game/Characters/Knight |

**返回**：TOON：section `candidates` + `co_occurring_bundle`

## TOON section 字段顺序

| section | 字段（顺序固定） |
| --- | --- |
| `candidates` | `logical_id`, `duration`, `forward_cm`, `strike_window`, `limb`, `score` |
| `co_occurring_bundle` | `logical_id`, `asset_class`, `weight`, `hint` |
| `similar_assets` | `logical_id`, `asset_class`, `similarity`, `shared_class` |
| `dependencies / referencers` | `logical_id`, `asset_path`, `depth`, `edge_type`, `weight`, `via_path` |
| `metrics` | `metric`, `value`, `detail` |
| `hotspots` | `logical_id`, `asset_class`, `referenced_by` |
| `families` | `family`, `asset_count` |
| `duplicate_pairs` | `lhs_id`, `rhs_id`, `similarity` |
| `features` | `logical_id`, `asset_class`, `feature_key`, `feature_value` |
| `feature_keys` | `feature_key`, `spec_source`, `asset_count` |
| `extensions` | `key`, `namespace`, `version`, `priority`, `applies_to`, `capabilities` |
| `index_revision` | `key`, `value` |
| `extension_fields` | `asset_path`, `namespace`, `field_name`, `value_type`, `value_display`, `provenance` |
| `extension_catalog` | `namespace`, `field_name`, `value_type`, `provenance`, `asset_count` |
| `asset_role` | `asset_path`, `role`, `provenance` |
| `assembly` | `asset_path`, `relation`, `target_role` |
| `official_tools` | `name`, `toolset`, `accessMode`, `inverse`, `risk` |
| `asset_paths / rescan_paths` | `asset_path` |
| `layer_stats` | `layer`, `status`, `changed_count`, `changed_fields`, `canonical_sha256`, `line_count`, `artifact`, `next_cursor`, `description`, `source` |
| `diff_layer` | `line_no`, `text` |
| `mismatches` | `artifact`, `reason`, `first_sha256`, `second_sha256` |
| `operations / inverse_ops / reverted_ops` | `id`, `tool`, `accessMode`, `inverse`, `risk`, `arguments_sha256` |
| `diff_preview` | `id`, `tool`, `accessMode`, `risk`, `arguments_sha256`, `change` |
| `results` | `id`, `tool`, `accessMode`, `status`, `dry_run`, `result_status`, `reason` |
| `per_op_result` | `id`, `tool`, `status`, `index_state`, `detail` |
| `residual_risks` | `risk` |
| `sections` | `section`, `count` |
| `errors` | `code`, `detail` |
| `stages` | `stage`, `status`, `result`, `artifact` |
| `assertions` | `id`, `status`, `result` |
| `lifecycle_events` | `event_id`, `event`, `status`, `hook_count`, `payload_keys` |
| `steps` | `step`, `name`, `status`, `result`, `artifact` |
| `allowlist_issues` | `rule_id`, `kind`, `message` |
| `runtime_result` | `key`, `value` |
| `ARTIFACT_PAGE_FIELDS` | `line_no`, `text` |
| `IMPORT_GAMESPEC_FIELDS` | `key`, `value` |

字段顺序与转义规则见 `docs/reference/protocol.md`。
